title: The Ice Choir
text: Figures stand frozen in a ring on the ice, mouths open, heads tipped back, hands joined. Frost has filled their eyes. When the wind moves across them they sing a low, terrible harmony that makes the ice beneath your feet hum.

options.label: Stop and listen to the frozen choir, taking whatever comfort it offers.

outcomes.text: The song is a lament for somewhere warm. It makes the cold easier to bear.
The song is an invitation. One of the figures is new, and it is wearing your clothes.

options.label: Break their ring and silence the song for good.

outcomes.text: The figures shatter like glass. Something under the ice is very angry about it.

options.label: Hurry past with your ears covered before the song can take hold.

outcomes.text: The song never reaches you, but the haste costs you; the cold bites into every strap and buckle.
